collections_rules_match_kind.name: collections_rules_match_kind
collections_rules_match_kind.value: ("store"."collections"."kind" = 'rule') = ("store"."collections"."rules" is not null) and not ("store"."collections"."kind" = 'rule' and "store"."collections"."sort" = 'manual')

product_attributes_value_matches_type.name: product_attributes_value_matches_type
product_attributes_value_matches_type.value:
case "store"."product_attributes"."attribute_type"
        when 'choice' then "store"."product_attributes"."value_id" is not null and "store"."product_attributes"."number_value" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."boolean_value" is null
        when 'multi_choice' then "store"."product_attributes"."value_id" is not null and "store"."product_attributes"."number_value" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."boolean_value" is null
        when 'number' then "store"."product_attributes"."value_id" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."number_value" is not null and "store"."product_attributes"."boolean_value" is null
        when 'boolean' then "store"."product_attributes"."value_id" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."number_value" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."boolean_value" is not null
        when 'text' then "store"."product_attributes"."value_id" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."number_value" is null and "store"."product_attributes"."boolean_value" is null
        else false end

variants_sku_unique.name: variants_sku_unique
variants_sku_unique.where: sku is not null and archived_at is null

variants_sale_valid.name: variants_sale_valid
variants_sale_valid.value:
"store"."variants"."sale_price" is null or ("store"."variants"."sale_price" >= 0 and "store"."variants"."sale_price" < "store"."variants"."price"
        and "store"."variants"."sale_starts_at" is not null and "store"."variants"."sale_ends_at" > "store"."variants"."sale_starts_at")

import_jobs_counts_valid.name: import_jobs_counts_valid
import_jobs_counts_valid.value:
"store"."import_jobs"."chunk_count" between 1 and 1000 and "store"."import_jobs"."next_chunk" between 0 and "store"."import_jobs"."chunk_count"
          and "store"."import_jobs"."processed" <= "store"."import_jobs"."total" and "store"."import_jobs"."created" + "store"."import_jobs"."updated" + "store"."import_jobs"."failed" <= "store"."import_jobs"."processed"

stock_movements_type_sign.name: stock_movements_type_sign
stock_movements_type_sign.value:
case "store"."stock_movements"."type"
        when 'receive' then "store"."stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
        when 'return' then "store"."stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
        when 'sale' then "store"."stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
        when 'reservation' then "store"."stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
        when 'release' then "store"."stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
        when 'adjustment' then "store"."stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0
        else false end

order_lines_amounts.name: order_lines_amounts
order_lines_amounts.value:
"store"."order_lines"."unit_price" >= 0 and "store"."order_lines"."line_subtotal" >= 0 and "store"."order_lines"."discount_total" between 0 and "store"."order_lines"."line_subtotal"
        and "store"."order_lines"."vat_amount" >= 0 and "store"."order_lines"."line_total" >= 0 and "store"."order_lines"."vat_rate_bp" between 0 and 10000

orders_amounts_non_negative.name: orders_amounts_non_negative
orders_amounts_non_negative.value:
"store"."orders"."subtotal" >= 0 and "store"."orders"."discount_total" >= 0 and "store"."orders"."delivery_fee" >= 0 and "store"."orders"."delivery_discount" >= 0
        and "store"."orders"."vat_total" >= 0 and "store"."orders"."total" >= 0 and "store"."orders"."paid_total" >= 0
        and "store"."orders"."discount_total" <= "store"."orders"."subtotal" and "store"."orders"."delivery_discount" <= "store"."orders"."delivery_fee"
